genes.name: inner_count
genes.hypothesis: Number of circles in the ring around the central circle (8 in OpenEvolve's initial program).
genes.author: seed

genes.name: inner_radius
genes.hypothesis: Distance of the inner ring from the centre of the square (0.3 in OpenEvolve's initial program).
genes.author: seed

genes.name: outer_count
genes.hypothesis: Number of circles in the outer ring (16 in OpenEvolve's initial program). Circles beyond the last ring slot are left at the origin, as the 26th is there.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: outer_radius
genes.hypothesis: Distance of the outer ring from the centre of the square (0.7 in OpenEvolve's initial program, which is outside the square, so the clip flattens the ring onto the sides).
genes.author: seed

genes.name: clip_margin
genes.hypothesis: Centres are clipped into [margin, 1 - margin] (0.01 in OpenEvolve's initial program); it is the radius available to a circle pushed against a side.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: local_perturbation
genes.hypothesis: Greedy local perturbation of circle centers: randomly move one circle by a small amount each iteration, keeping improvements. This introduces search dynamics that gradually refine the packing.
genes.author: llm:claude-haiku-4-5

genes.name: perturbation_radius
genes.hypothesis: Standard deviation of the Gaussian perturbation applied to each circle centre.
genes.author: llm:claude-haiku-4-5

genes.name: azimuth_phase
genes.hypothesis: Offset every other ring by half the angular spacing to reduce inter-ring blocking and improve packing density in the ring-based structure.
genes.author: llm:claude-haiku-4-5

genes.name: efficient_pair_distances
genes.hypothesis: Vectorize pairwise distance computations using numpy broadcasting in compute_max_radii to reduce Python loop overhead and improve throughput, enabling more iterations within the same time budget.
genes.author: llm:claude-haiku-4-5
genes.predicted: +0.01 to +0.02 points on instances with more iterations; +0 if overhead cancels benefit for n=26

genes.name: vectorized_separation
genes.hypothesis: Vectorize the separation loop using numpy boolean operations to check for conflicting centers, replacing the Python generator comprehension with array operations to reduce interpreter overhead and improve throughput when resolving duplicate or near-duplicate center positions.
genes.author: llm:claude-haiku-4-5
genes.predicted: +0.005 to +0.02 points through reduced separation overhead

genes.name: lazy_separation
genes.hypothesis: Skip expensive separation verification when centers are already distinct and clipped, avoiding redundant distance checks and improving throughput by reducing work per iteration.
genes.author: llm:claude-haiku-4-5
genes.predicted: +0.01 to +0.03 points through reduced separation overhead in the improve loop

genes.name: occasional_jumps
genes.hypothesis: With low probability each iteration, make large random perturbations to several circles simultaneously, allowing escape from plateaus and exploring distant regions of the search space without expensive convergence.
genes.author: llm:claude-haiku-4-5
genes.predicted: +0.05 to +0.15 points by enabling occasional large moves that escape plateaus

genes.name: jump_probability
genes.hypothesis: Probability per iteration of making a large random jump to escape local optima.
genes.author: llm:claude-haiku-4-5

genes.name: jump_count
genes.hypothesis: Number of circles to perturb in each jump move.
genes.author: llm:claude-haiku-4-5
